name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: A short burst of flat paper pieces in the chart colours from a point, falling and fading on a canvas over the page, started from code (the handle's `fire`) and never under reduced motion; it says nothing and takes no clicks.

meta.when: Marking a rare success the person worked for: a first project published, a goal reached. Never for routine actions, never on page load. Say the success in words as well (a toast, a heading): the burst is decoration.
